# Troops — space4k

Only attack troops can be sent on missions; defense troops never leave their building.

**`base_defense` is the raw class value.** In this ruleset `troop_defense_multiplier` = **1**: every troop's effective defense starts from `base_defense × 1` ([05-formulas.md](../05-formulas.md#troop-effective-stats)).
